methods.text: not available for Nebraska: NDOT's only published costs (ne_hso_costs_2020, p. 1) are economic costs per person, not per crash: $1,550,000 per death, $90,000 per disabling (A), $26,000 per visible (B), $21,000 per possible (C) injury, and $4,200 per property-damage crash; NTIP gives no person counts to price them
